name: LiveKit Agents
summary: Python framework for building realtime voice AI agents with STT, LLM, TTS, WebRTC and telephony integrations.
description: A Python framework for building realtime, programmable voice AI agents that run on servers. Mix and match STT, LLM, TTS and realtime APIs, connect users over LiveKit's WebRTC clients or telephony, and use built-in job scheduling, semantic turn detection, MCP support and a test framework with judges. The whole stack, including the LiveKit server, is open source and self-hostable.
contains: mix-and-match STT, LLM, TTS and realtime API plugins
job scheduling and dispatch for agents
